rows.corpus_definition: To stop doing something or to come to an end.
rows.example_en: The rain will cease in the afternoon.

rows.corpus_definition: A situation where everything is confused and not organized.
rows.example_en: The room was in total chaos after the party.

rows.corpus_definition: To love someone or something very much.
rows.example_en: I cherish the memories of our trip.

rows.corpus_definition: A written record of events in the order they happened.
rows.example_en: This book is a detailed chronicle of the war.

rows.corpus_definition: A large family or group of relatives.
rows.example_en: The whole clan gathered for the party.

rows.corpus_definition: A group of things that are close together.
rows.example_en: A small cluster of stars was visible in the sky.

rows.corpus_definition: To happen at the same time.
rows.example_en: Our vacations will coincide this year.

rows.corpus_definition: A high-ranking officer in the army.
rows.example_en: The colonel gave orders to the waiting soldiers.

rows.corpus_definition: The activity of buying and selling products on a large scale.
rows.example_en: Global commerce helps countries grow their wealth.

rows.corpus_definition: A strong feeling of sadness for those who are suffering.
rows.example_en: He showed great compassion for the victims.
